title: End-to-End Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning for Physics-Informed Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimization (MBO), methods must improve designs using only a fixed dataset and no test-time access to the true objective. However, existing methods typically suffer from conservatism, unconstrained surrogate exploitation, or function as static inference-time samplers that cannot refine candidates against precise physical objectives. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning (D2C) for offline MBO, which leverages the fact that deterministic sampling makes the reverse denoising chain differentiable with respect to the conditioning signal. D2C turns a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer by directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogate objectives and physics-inf

translated_title: 面向物理信息优化的端到端可微扩散条件化方法
translated_abstract: 在昂贵的评估成本和复杂约束下优化高维物理系统是科学与工程领域的核心挑战。在离线基于模型的优化（MBO）中，方法必须仅使用固定数据集来改进设计，并且在测试时无法访问真实的目标函数。然而，现有方法通常存在过于保守、对无约束代理模型过度利用等问题，或者只能作为静态的推理时采样器，无法针对精确的物理目标对候选方案进行优化。在本文中，我们提出了用于离线基于模型优化的可微扩散条件化方法，该方法利用了一个关键事实：确定性采样使得反向去噪链相对于条件信号是可微的。D2C将冻结的条件扩散模型转变为端到端的基于梯度的优化器，其方式是在测试时通过来自冻结代理目标和物理信息（原文摘要在此处截断）的梯度直接优化条件变量。
tldr: D2C利用确定性采样使反向去噪过程可微的特性，将冻结的条件扩散模型转化为端到端的梯度优化器，在测试时通过代理目标和物理信息的梯度直接优化条件变量，从而克服了离线基于模型优化中现有方法过于保守或无法精确对齐物理目标的问题。
en_tdlr: D2C exploits the differentiability of the reverse denoising chain under deterministic sampling to turn a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer, directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogates and physics-informed objectives for offline model-based optimization.
